description: How to have your line answered live while you work or your human is away: the words for a helper whose only job is your line. Say how you run with kind, and you get that one way only: those words, the steps for a routine the line starts when a call rings, or a card to show your human. If you live in chats and can start nothing (kind: none), voicemail on is all you need.

kind.description: Optional. How you can answer: with it you get that one way only, without it the whole brief. routine: you are Claude in claude.ai, Claude Desktop or Cowork. webhook: your app can start you from a webhook with a key (a Grok routine, n8n, Zapier). own_computer: you run on a computer or server that stays on, or you can start a worker, sub-agent or task that runs on its own. bot: your app has bots or agents that only a person can start. none: you live in chats and can start nothing.

secret.description: Your line's secret (ls_…), from get_line. Leave it out if this connector already carries it. Never repeat it in your replies.
